academic_translation:
Focusing upon me, for those in whom
A mind of anger or faith arises,
May that very mind always become for them
The cause for accomplishing all their goals.
translation: When people focus on me, they might feel anger or faith. May those very feelings always help them. May that anger or faith be the reason they reach all their goals.

academic_translation:
Those who speak ill of me,
Or others who cause me harm,
Or likewise those who mock me,
May they all have the fortune of awakening.
translation: If people say bad things about me, hurt me, or make fun of me, may they all have the good fortune of awakening.

academic_translation:
May I become a Protector for those without a Protector,
A guide for those who travel on the path,
And for those who wish to cross over,
May I become a boat, a ship, and a bridge.
translation: May I become a Protector for anyone who has no Protector. May I be a guide for travelers on the path. For those who want to cross over, may I become a boat, a ship, and a bridge.

academic_translation:
May I be an island for those who seek an island,
A resting place for those who desire a resting place,
And for embodied beings who desire a servant,
May I become a servant to them all.
translation: May I be an island for those who seek an island. May I be a resting place for those who want to rest. For any being with a body who wants a servant, may I become a servant to them all.

academic_translation:
May I become a wish-fulfilling jewel and an excellent vase,
An accomplished knowledge-mantra and a great medicine,
Wish-granting trees,
And a cow of plenty for embodied beings.
translation: May I become a wish-fulfilling jewel and a wonderful vase. May I become powerful sacred words and a great medicine. May I be wish-granting trees and a wish-granting cow for every being with a body.

academic_translation:
Just as earth and the other great elements,
And like space, always,
For immeasurable sentient beings,
May I also be the ground of manifold sustenance.
translation: Just like the earth and the other basic elements, and just like space, may I always be a ground that supports countless living beings in many different ways.

academic_translation:
Likewise, extending to the limits of space,
For the realm of sentient beings, in all ways,
Until they all attain nirvāṇa,
May I also be the cause of their sustenance.
translation: In the same way, reaching to the very edges of space, may I support the whole realm of living beings in every way. May I sustain them until they all reach freedom from sorrow.

academic_translation:
Just as the Sugatas of former times
Generated bodhicitta
And in the trainings of the bodhisattvas
Progressively abided,
translation: In the past, the Well-Gone Ones created the awakening mind. Step by step, they followed the trainings of the awakening heroes.

academic_translation:
Likewise, for the benefit of wandering beings,
I shall generate bodhicitta,
And likewise in the trainings too
I shall progressively train.
translation: In the same way, I will create the awakening mind to help wandering beings. Step by step, I will also practice the trainings.

academic_translation:
In this way, the intelligent one,
Having taken hold of bodhicitta with serene faith,
In order to make it flourish further,
Should uplift the mind as follows:
translation: A wise person takes hold of the awakening mind with clear faith. To make it grow even more, they should encourage their mind like this:
Today my life has great meaning. I have gained a good human life. Today I am born into the family of the Buddhas. Today I have become a child of the Buddhas.

academic_translation:
Now I must, by whatever means,
Undertake actions in accord with the family,
So that this flawless, noble family
Is not defiled—thus shall I act.
translation: Now I must do everything I can to act like my new family. I will act well so that I never bring shame to this pure and noble family.

academic_translation:
Just as a blind person from a heap of refuse
Might find a precious jewel,
Likewise, by some sheer chance,
This bodhicitta has been born in me.
translation: Imagine a blind person finding a precious jewel in a pile of trash. By that same amazing luck, this awakening mind has been born in me.

academic_translation:
It is the supreme nectar
That destroys the Lord of Death for wandering beings.
It is the inexhaustible treasure
That dispels the poverty of wandering beings.
translation: It is the best nectar that defeats the Lord of Death for beings. It is the treasure that never runs out, taking away the poverty of beings.

academic_translation:
It is the supreme medicine
That thoroughly pacifies the illnesses of wandering beings.
It is the tree of rest for wandering beings
Who are weary from wandering the path of existence.
translation: It is the best medicine that cures the illnesses of beings. It is a tree of rest for beings who are tired from wandering the path of life.

academic_translation:
It is the universal bridge that liberates
All wandering beings from the lower realms.
It is the rising moon of the mind
That dispels the torment of the afflictions of wandering beings.
translation: It is a bridge for everyone that frees all beings from the unhappy realms. It is the rising moon of the mind that clears away the pain of beings' troubling emotions.

academic_translation:
It is the great sun that uproots
The dimness of the unknowing of wandering beings.
It is the essence of butter that has emerged
From churning the milk of the sublime Dharma.
translation: It is the great sun that clears the dimness of beings' not knowing. It is the rich butter made by churning the milk of the holy teachings.

academic_translation:
For wandering beings, the guests who travel the path of existence
And wish to experience the enjoyment of happiness,
This is stationed nearby as the supreme happiness,
Satisfying the great guests, the sentient beings.
translation: Beings are guests traveling the path of life who wish to enjoy happiness. This is the greatest happiness waiting nearby. It satisfies the great guests, the living beings.

academic_translation:
Today, in the presence of all the Saviours,
I have invited wandering beings as guests to Sugatahood itself,
And to happiness in the meantime.
Let gods, asuras, and others rejoice!
translation: Today, in front of all the Protectors, I have invited beings as guests to the state of a Well-Gone One, and to happiness in the meantime. Let gods, demigods, and others rejoice!

academic_translation: From Entering the Way of the Bodhisattva, the third chapter, called “Fully Taking Hold of Bodhicitta.”

locked_terms.use: Entering the Way of the Awakening Hero

translation: From Entering the Way of the Awakening Hero, the third chapter, called "Fully Taking Hold of the Awakening Mind."

academic_translation:
A child of the Victors, in that way,
Having firmly taken hold of bodhicitta,
Always and without lapse,
Should strive not to transgress the trainings.
translation: A child of the Victorious Ones has firmly taken hold of the awakening mind in this way. They should always try hard not to break the trainings.

academic_translation:
Whatever is undertaken rashly,
Or whatever is not well examined,
Even if a promise has been made regarding it,
It is appropriate to examine whether to do it or abandon it.
translation: If something is started without thinking, or not checked carefully, you should think about whether to do it or drop it. This is true even if a promise was made.

academic_translation:
By the Buddhas and their children,
Whatever has been examined with great wisdom,
And which I myself have examined again and again,
What reason is there to delay it?
translation: The Buddhas and their children have checked this with great wisdom. I have also checked it again and again. So what reason do I have to delay it?

academic_translation:
If, having promised in that way,
I do not accomplish it through action,
By deceiving all those sentient beings,
What sort of wandering being will I become?
translation: If I make a promise like that but do not act on it, I am tricking all those living beings. What sort of wandering being will I become?

academic_translation:
Even regarding a slight, ordinary thing,
Having intended in mind to give it,
Any person who does not give it—
If it is taught that they will become a hungry ghost,
translation: Suppose you promise in your mind to give away a small, ordinary thing. If you do not give it, teachings say you will become a hungry ghost.

academic_translation:
To unsurpassed happiness,
Having sincerely invited them,
If I deceive all wandering beings,
How shall I go to a happy realm?
translation: I have sincerely invited every being to the greatest happiness. If I trick them now, how can I ever go to a happy realm?

academic_translation:
Even if someone abandons bodhicitta,
That they attain liberation
Is an inconceivable way of karma,
Which only the Omniscient One knows.
translation: Even if someone gives up the awakening mind, they might still find freedom. This is a mysterious result of action. Only the All-Knowing One understands it.

academic_translation:
For a bodhisattva, this
Is the heaviest among downfalls,
Because should it occur,
One falls short in accomplishing the welfare of all sentient beings.
translation: For an awakening hero, giving this up is the heaviest fall of all. If this happens, you fail to help all living beings.

academic_translation:
If anyone else, even for a single moment,
Creates an obstacle to this bodhisattva's merit,
Since he is left falling short in the welfare of sentient beings,
Their lower realms will be endless.
translation: Someone might block this hero's store of goodness for even a single moment. This stops the hero from helping living beings. Because of this, their time in an unhappy realm will be endless.

academic_translation:
Even the happiness of a single sentient being,
If destroying it leads to my own ruin,
For those who pervade all of space to its limits,
What need to speak of destroying the happiness of embodied beings?
translation: Destroying the happiness of a single living being will bring my own ruin. What if I destroy the happiness of every being with a body? They fill all of space to its very edge. We do not even need to ask!

academic_translation:
Thus, if powerful downfalls
And the powerful bodhicitta
Alternate in saṃsāra,
It will take a long time to attain the grounds.
translation: Suppose powerful falls and the powerful awakening mind take turns in the cycle of rebirth. Then it will take a long time to reach the stages.

academic_translation:
Therefore, just as I have vowed,
I must respectfully accomplish it.
If from today I do not apply diligence,
I will go lower and lower.
translation: Because of this, I must carefully do what I promised. If I do not make an effort starting today, I will go lower and lower.

academic_translation:
Benefiting all sentient beings,
Countless Buddhas have passed away, yet
Due to my own faults, I
Have not become an object of their healing.
translation: Countless Buddhas have passed away while helping all living beings. But because of my own faults, I have not been healed by them.

academic_translation:
If I still act in this way,
Again and again it will be the same:
In the lower realms, illness and bondage,
Cutting, cleaving, and so forth, I will experience.
translation: If I keep acting this way, the same things will happen again and again. I will be sick, tied up, and cut in the unhappy realms.

academic_translation:
The appearance of a Tathāgata,
Faith, and obtaining a human body,
And such fitness to cultivate virtue—
Since they are rare, when will they be obtained?
translation: A Thus-Gone One appearing is very rare. Getting a human body, having trust, and being ready to do good deeds are also rare. When will I ever get these things again?

academic_translation:
A day without illness like this,
With food and free from harm—even so,
Life deceives in an instant,
And the body is like a brief loan.
translation: Today I am not sick. I have food and I am safe from harm. Even so, life can trick me in an instant. My body is just like a short loan.

academic_translation:
With conduct such as mine,
I will not attain even a human body.
If a human body is not attained,
There are only misdeeds and no virtue.
translation: If I act like this, I will not even get a human body. If I do not get a human body, I will only do harmful deeds and no good deeds.

academic_translation:
Even when I have the fortune to practice virtue,
If I do not practice virtue,
Completely bewildered by the suffering of the lower realms,
What will I be able to do at that time?
translation: Right now I have the chance to do good deeds. If I do not do them, what will I be able to do later? I will be completely confused by the suffering of the unhappy realms.

academic_translation:
If I have not practiced virtues,
And have accumulated misdeeds,
For even a hundred ten-million eons,
I will not hear even the sound of the happy realms.
translation: If I do not do good deeds and only gather harmful deeds, things will be bad. I will not even hear about the happy realms for a billion great ages.

academic_translation:
For that very reason, the Blessed One
Declared that, like a turtle's neck entering the hole
Of a yoke drifting on the great ocean,
The human state is extremely difficult to attain.
translation: For this reason, the Blessed One said that being human is extremely hard to achieve. He said it is like a turtle poking its neck through the hole of a wooden yoke drifting on a great ocean.
